summary: Balaam sees in vision and prophesies of the destiny of Israel—He prophesies of the Messiah: There will come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre will rise out of Israel.
meta_description: Balaam sees in vision and prophesies of the destiny of Israel—He prophesies of the Messiah: There will come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre will rise out of Israel.

footnotes.note7_a: HEB Water shall flow from his branches.
footnotes.note17_a: IE His coming was to be in the future, long after Moses’ time.
